description: Validate a VAT number: format and checksum on every call. Deep asks the live EU registry for registered, legal name, and address. Pass from with your own VAT for a consultation identifier.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code when the number has no prefix, e.g. US

deep.description: Include the nested deep object when available. Pricing depends on the operation.

from.description: Your own VAT number. Returns a consultation identifier for your audit file

number.description: VAT number, with or without the country prefix

name: vat
